notes: v2.5.24 - recommended update. Quotes: one planned-hours figure on both tabs, build a planner from the parts plan, planned vs worked and what finished jobs used, a simple view for old quotes, and budgets split across a quote's builds. Requisitions need a real vendor and pick parts from a new catalog explorer; inventory POs start with certs and AS9100 clauses on. Receiving can take a receipt back and says why a receipt is refused. Outsourcing tracks each order out to the vendor and back. Shop computers can raise NCRs under the person badged in. Signed ECN uploads offer Mark as sent. Kitted parts stay with their assembly, bulk Location edits work on ticked rows, and quote and project files open on PCs without Z:. This release also updates the database.
